text:
Maya: Heads-up — two support tickets about tenant rate limits from ACME. Tickets: https://support.redwood.ai/t/4567 and https://support.redwood.ai/t/4572. They look like duplicates but slightly different asks (burst capacity vs sustained quota). Can PMs weigh in on merging and priority? I propose we merge under 4567 and mark as 'needs-scope'. cc @Tom for context.

Tom: Yep both from same customer, same account. 4567 requested temporary burst to 10k req/min for launch next month. 4572 asks permanent quota bump. Customer asks for ETA.

Priya: +1. Product here. I'd prefer we treat as single epic with two sub-requests. Need to know: (1) Is launch date hard? (2) Expected traffic profile? (3) Security/regulatory constraints? If launch is tight, we can scope a short-term temporary bump + rollout plan. Can CS confirm timeline and whether they can accept a rolling rollout?

Carlos: From SE: ACME is on Dedicated, we can do routing + reserved pool. We can offer opt-in burst config but infra needs lead time to reserve GPUs. Daniel, how long to provision burst policy?

Daniel: Engineering: reserve pool + config ~2 weeks if capacity available; 4-6 weeks worst-case. Also need a rate-limiter migration and a simple config snippet:
```
rate_limit:
  tenant_id: acme
  burst: 10000
  sustained: 3000
```

Elena: Sales — customer wants 'day 1' launch in 3 weeks. They're enterprise and will pay for reservation if we can guarantee. Need clear ask to confirm SOW.

Maya: Proposal: Merge tickets -> canonical ticket 4567; product label 'cust-request/quota'; severity=P2; owner=Priya. Action items: CS confirm timeline, SE check capacity, ENG provide provisioning ETA and rollback plan. I'll update both tickets and notify the customer. Agree?

Tom: Agree. I'll update 4572 with a link to 4567 and set status "merged". Pinging ACME for timeline confirmation now.

Priya: Assigning to me. Prioritization note: if they pay for reserved capacity, escalate to P1 and fast-track; otherwise P2 into capacity sprint. Confirm when sales gets SOW.

support_bot: Ticket 4572 marked as merged into 4567 by Tom — automated.

Maya: :thumbsup: Thanks. I'll draft the customer response to say we've merged and outline next steps and ETA options (2w reserved vs 4-6w standard).

Carlos: One more: backlog tagging — customer:acme, type:quota, merge_to:4567, priority:pending-sales. I'll add cost note in the ticket.

Priya: Launch criteria (for product): performance verified at 10k rps for 1 hour, error-rate <1%, and fallback route to hosted models. If fail, plan B = gradual ramp + throttling.

Daniel: Will post a runbook and provisioning checklist in the ticket after capacity check.

Maya: Perfect. Tom please confirm when ticket updated. I'll add a short line in tomorrow's roadmap grooming to include this epic for scoping.
